director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Chalo, shuru karein?
pata nahi

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Cricket pitch ke kinaare kone se chalkar wahin lauto: yahi parimap hai. Isi tarah triangle ka bhi niklega. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Board par triangle ki har bhuja par uska naap likha hai. Ungli jin bhujaon se guzri, un sabke naap milakar socho. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Haan, Hindi mein batati hoon. Socho is triangle ka kinaara ek dhaage se bana hai. Ek kone se dhaaga khol ke seedha kar do: 4 cm, phir 5 cm, phir 6 cm, sab ek line mein. Us seedhi line ki poori lambai hi parimap hai. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 15 cm

Sahi jawab, kyunki 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare mein aati hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: pata nahi
Ungli ko hexagon ke kinaare par ek poora chakkar ghumao, aur har bhuja par uski lambai jodte jao. Is hexagon ki ek bhuja par 5 cm likha hai; poore hexagon ka parimap kitne cm hai?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: thirty

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 6 bhujayein, har ek 5 cm: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: pehle 6, phir bagal ki bhuja 4, phir 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 20 cm

Bilkul sahi: dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Phoolon ki kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m. Kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni baad bachegi, yeh jaanne se pehle kya nikaalna hoga?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao

Yahan kyari ka kinaara khol kar seedhi line bana di hai. Maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Kyari ki bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m hain, aur maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Bachi baad ka hisaab kis naap se shuru hoga?

picture.line: Is triangle ki 3 bhujayein seedhi karke ek line par rakhi hain: 8 m, 9 m, 14 m; kul lambai kitni hai

director.text: pata nahi

Socho, tumhare paas 35 rupaye hain aur tum ek kitaab khareedte ho. Kitne bachenge, yeh kitaab ka daam jaane bina pata nahi chalta; maali ki baad mein bhi aisa hi kuch pehle jaanna hoga. Kitni baad bachegi, yeh jaanne se pehle kya nikaalna hoga?

Kyari ki bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m hain, aur maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Bachi baad ka hisaab kis naap se shuru hoga?

Pehle dekhna hai ki kyari ke poore kinaare par kitni baad lagegi, yaani kyari ka parimap. Baad kinaare par hi lagti hai. Ab teeno bhujayein jodte hain: 8 + 9 + 14 = 31 m. Kyari ke poore kinaare par itni baad lagegi. Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?
director.card: Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: pata nahi
35 m mein se jitni baad kyari par lag gayi, utni hata do; jo reh gayi, wahi bachi. Kyari par 31 m baad lagi; maali ki 35 m mein se kitni bachegi?

Haan, pehle tum try karo.

director.text: 18 m sahi nahi hai. Isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. Khet ke kone P par ungli rakho, aur har bhuja ka naam lekar uski lambai jodo. Jod tab poora, jab ungli wapas P par ho. Khet PQRST: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

Sahi jawab, kyunki P se wapas P tak paanchon bhujayein: 8 + 5 + 7 + 6 + 3 = 29 m. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Kyari par 31 m baad lagi; maali ki 35 m mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: 18 m se baat nahi bani. Socho tum kyari ke ek kone par khade ho. 8 m chalo, mudo, 9 m chalo, mudo, phir 14 m chal ke wahin pahunch jao. Baad utni hi lagegi jitna tum chale; maali ki 35 m mein se baaki bachegi. Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: 18 m sahi nahi hai. Ek chhoti cheez se socho: rumaal ke chaaron taraf lace lagani ho, toh lace har bhuja par lagti hai, aur kul lace un sab bhujaon ka jod hoti hai. Kyari ki baad bhi aisi hi hai, bas bhujayein teen hain. Kyari par 31 m baad lagi; maali ki 35 m mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Iska jawab hai maali ke paas 4 m baad bachegi, kyunki 35 m mein se 31 m baad kyari ke kinaare par lag gayi. Ab tak samajh aaya?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka

Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai. Ab apni padhai par lautte hain. Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Park ke chaaron taraf ek baar ghoomne mein kitne metre chalne padenge?

Sahi jawab. Dekho, chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

Haan, sahi hai: parimap kinaara hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe nahi pata

Achha, pehle main dikhati hoon. Is rectangle ki do lambi bhujayein 10 m ki hain, woh lambai hai. Do chhoti bhujayein 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 32 m hai na

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 10 aur 6 do-do baar, kul 32 m. Naya rectangle: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Neeche baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m upar. Ab tum saamne wale kone par ho, yaani aadha chakkar. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?
director.card: Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?
